How did Metallica draw a massive crowd in Moscow in 1991?
The legendary concert became a defining moment in rock history.
On September 28, 1991, Metallica performed at the Monsters of Rock festival at Tushino Airfield in Moscow, during a period of major change across the Soviet Union. The event featured several international rock bands and attracted an enormous audience eager to experience live music on an unprecedented scale. The Met Gala Photo That Uncovered a 2,100-Year-Old Secret #history
candidates.source_description:
In 2018, Kim Kardashian posed beside an ancient Egyptian artifact at the Met Gala in New York City.
At the time, it looked like just another museum piece.
But that photo would later become connected to a much bigger story involving fake documents, an international investigation, and an artifact that should never have left Egypt.
